entries.en: The wagons formed a laager around the travelers' camp.
entries.zh: 马车围成车阵，护住了旅行者的营地。

entries.en: The simulation represents the colony's aggregative behavior as separate cells joining clusters.
entries.zh: 模拟把菌落的聚集行为表示为单个细胞加入细胞群。

entries.en: The sousaphone player struggled to turn in the narrow corridor.
entries.zh: 苏萨号演奏者费力地在狭窄走廊中转身。

entries.en: The novel's soldier of fortune changes employers after each campaign.
entries.zh: 小说中的雇佣兵每场战役结束后都会更换雇主。

entries.en: We waited an hour or so before the doors opened.
entries.zh: 我们等了一个小时左右，门才打开。

entries.en: During the difficult move, her neighbor was a tower of strength.
entries.zh: 在那次艰难的搬家过程中，邻居成了她可靠的支柱。

entries.en: The worksheet asks students to calculate the isotope's half life.
entries.zh: 练习要求学生计算这种同位素的半衰期。

entries.en: The old wall formed the city's last line of defense.
entries.zh: 这道旧城墙构成了城市最后的防线。

entries.en: The editor promised to check into the disputed quotation.
entries.zh: 编辑答应调查那段有争议的引文。

entries.en: We applied the law of gravitation to the simplified orbit model.
entries.zh: 我们把万有引力定律应用于这个简化的轨道模型。

entries.en: The author's fictionalization of the journey adds an invented traveling companion.
entries.zh: 作者把旅程小说化时，添加了一位虚构的旅伴。

entries.en: The historian traced the poet's expatriation through letters from exile.
entries.zh: 历史学家通过诗人的流亡书信追溯了他被放逐国外的经历。

entries.en: My amigo brought his guitar to our farewell picnic.
entries.zh: 我的朋友带着吉他来参加我们的告别野餐。

entries.en: The case file included records of missed child support payments.
entries.zh: 案卷中包含了未按时支付子女抚养费的记录。

entries.en: Each age group has a separate starting time for the race.
entries.zh: 每个年龄组都有不同的比赛出发时间。

entries.en: The inn's handwritten bill of fare listed only three dishes.
entries.zh: 客栈手写的菜单上只有三道菜。

entries.en: The council's water development plan includes restoring the neglected reservoir.
entries.zh: 议会的水利开发计划包括修复那座疏于维护的水库。

entries.en: Rich sauces disagree with me, so I ordered plain rice.
entries.zh: 油腻的酱汁让我肠胃不适，所以我点了白米饭。

entries.en: Our librarian was in on the project from its first planning meeting.
entries.zh: 我们的图书管理员从第一次筹划会议起就参与了这个项目。

entries.en: The botanist sketched the plant's smooth, elliptic leaves.
entries.zh: 植物学家画下了这种植物光滑的椭圆形叶片。

entries.en: The hoaxer admitted inventing the photograph of a sea monster.
entries.zh: 那个恶作剧骗子承认，海怪照片是他伪造的。

entries.en: Rain blew slantwise through the open window.
entries.zh: 雨斜着吹进敞开的窗户。

entries.en: The missing permit sent us from pillar to post for a week.
entries.zh: 缺失的许可证使我们奔波碰壁了一个星期。

entries.en: Ask Priya; she is up on the latest changes to the schedule.
entries.zh: 问普丽娅吧，她熟悉日程的最新变动。

entries.en: He led the investors on with promises he never intended to keep.
entries.zh: 他用根本不打算兑现的承诺哄骗投资者。

entries.en: Engineers tested the capsule's life support before the simulated mission.
entries.zh: 工程师在模拟任务前测试了太空舱的生命维持设备。

entries.en: The warehouse was on fire when the night guard arrived.
entries.zh: 夜班保安赶到时，仓库已经起火了。

entries.en: The dermatology lecture included a slide on keratosis.
entries.zh: 皮肤科讲座中有一张介绍角化病的幻灯片。

entries.en: The cave walls glistened moistly in the lantern light.
entries.zh: 洞壁在提灯照耀下泛着潮湿的光。

entries.en: The recording reveals the asynchrony between the drummer and the dancers.
entries.zh: 录像显示了鼓手与舞者之间的不同步。

entries.en: The court papers named her aunt as the child's next friend.
entries.zh: 法院文件指定她的姨妈担任该儿童的诉讼代理人。

entries.en: The air group assembled its squadrons for the training exercise.
entries.zh: 空军大队集结所属中队参加训练演习。

entries.en: Please leave behind the heavy books when you pack.
entries.zh: 打包时，请把那些沉重的书留下。

entries.en: Both choices would bankrupt the shop; it was a no-win situation.
entries.zh: 两种选择都会使商店破产，实在是个无解的困局。

entries.en: The nurse asked about diabetes while recording his family history.
entries.zh: 护士记录他的家族史时，询问了糖尿病的情况。

entries.en: Our word game rewards players for guessing a hidden noun.
entries.zh: 我们的猜词游戏奖励猜出隐藏名词的玩家。

entries.en: The teacher circled a phonogram representing a single sound.
entries.zh: 老师圈出了一个表示单个语音的表音符号。

entries.en: The surveyor checked the slope with an inclinometer.
entries.zh: 测量员用倾角计检查了坡度。

entries.en: By dawn, the bakeshop smelled of warm bread.
entries.zh: 黎明时，面包烘房里弥漫着热面包的香味。

entries.en: The carpenter ordered a great hundred of nails for the new roof.
entries.zh: 木匠为新屋顶订购了一百二十枚钉子。

entries.en: The water level rose above the lowest step overnight.
entries.zh: 一夜之间，水位涨过了最下面一级台阶。

entries.en: After twenty years in public service, she retired from the ministry.
entries.zh: 任公职二十年后，她从部里退休了。

entries.en: The repair will cost fifty dollars, give or take a little.
entries.zh: 修理费大约五十美元，上下略有出入。

entries.en: Her first language is Arabic, but she also speaks Italian.
entries.zh: 她的母语是阿拉伯语，不过她也会说意大利语。

entries.en: The parish announced extra Masses for the holy day of obligation.
entries.zh: 教区宣布在当守瞻礼日增加弥撒场次。

entries.en: His cryptology project analyzes a notebook full of encrypted messages.
entries.zh: 他的密码学项目分析了一本写满加密信息的笔记本。

entries.en: She strapped her feet onto the wakeboard before the boat accelerated.
entries.zh: 船加速前，她把双脚固定在花式滑水板上。

entries.en: The villagers rebelled against the tyrannous governor's arbitrary punishments.
entries.zh: 村民们反抗暴虐总督的任意惩罚。

entries.en: The landing was a near thing; one wheel barely cleared the ditch.
entries.zh: 这次降落险些出事，一个轮子勉强越过了沟渠。

entries.en: The parade will close the high street until noon.
entries.zh: 游行将使镇上的主街封闭到中午。

entries.en: Two witnesses came forward after seeing the appeal.
entries.zh: 看到征集线索的呼吁后，两名证人站了出来。

entries.en: The dealer tried to pull a fast one with a forged receipt.
entries.zh: 商贩企图用伪造的收据耍个骗局。

entries.en: The course compares this theory of gravity with earlier explanations of planetary motion.
entries.zh: 课程把这种引力理论与早期对行星运动的解释进行了比较。

entries.en: The historical map marked a house of prostitution beside the docks.
entries.zh: 这张历史地图在码头旁标出了一家妓院。

entries.en: A recurring health problem kept him from attending rehearsals.
entries.zh: 一个反复出现的健康问题使他无法参加排练。

entries.en: The shepherd repaired the sheepfold before bringing the flock home.
entries.zh: 牧羊人在赶羊群回来之前修好了羊圈。

entries.en: From the hilltop, the desert seemed illimitable.
entries.zh: 从山顶望去，沙漠似乎无边无际。

entries.en: Even in serious photographs, he was the family's persistent smiler.
entries.zh: 即使拍严肃的照片，他也是家里那个总带笑容的人。

entries.en: The almanac lists sunrise according to local civil time.
entries.zh: 年鉴按当地标准时间列出日出时刻。

entries.en: These handwritten letters fall under the archive's private correspondence category.
entries.zh: 这些手写信归入档案馆的私人通信类别。

entries.en: The traveling judge moved around the district hearing local cases.
entries.zh: 巡回法官在辖区各地走动，审理当地案件。

entries.en: The application must reach the correct government department by Friday.
entries.zh: 申请必须在周五前送达对应的政府部门。

entries.en: The artist carved an earless animal with a smooth, round head.
entries.zh: 艺术家雕了一只没有耳朵、头部圆滑的动物。

entries.en: The old sailor called the ship's surgeon the sawbones.
entries.zh: 老水手把船上的外科医生戏称为“锯骨匠”。

entries.en: Her eyes began to film over as she watched the farewell scene.
entries.zh: 看着告别的场景，她的双眼渐渐朦胧起来。

entries.en: The inquiry examined an alleged breach of duty by the building inspector.
entries.zh: 调查审查了建筑检查员涉嫌失职的问题。

entries.en: He arrived with a black eye after being struck by a ball.
entries.zh: 他被球击中后，带着一只瘀青的眼睛来了。

entries.en: The students compared how each economic system allocates scarce resources.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了各经济制度如何分配稀缺资源。

entries.en: The investigation found that the owner was merely a front man for smugglers.
entries.zh: 调查发现，那个老板只是走私者的挂名负责人。

entries.en: Delivery vans use the local road behind the shops.
entries.zh: 送货车使用商店后面的支路。

entries.en: Saute the mushrooms briefly before adding the cooked rice.
entries.zh: 先把蘑菇快速炒一下，再加入熟米饭。

entries.en: The pharmacy student checked the spelling of clonidine in the catalog.
entries.zh: 药学学生核对了目录中可乐定的拼写。

entries.en: The anatomy chart labels the fundus at the stomach's upper end.
entries.zh: 解剖图标出了胃上端的胃底。

entries.en: The local authority approved repairs to the footbridge.
entries.zh: 地方当局批准了人行桥的维修。

entries.en: He chipped away at the old plaster until the brickwork appeared.
entries.zh: 他一点点凿去旧灰泥，直到露出砖墙。

entries.en: An unwanted side effect of the redesign was slower navigation.
entries.zh: 这次重新设计带来了一个不良副作用：导航变慢了。

entries.en: The tied match went into extra time after the final whistle.
entries.zh: 终场哨响后，平局的比赛进入了加时赛。

entries.en: In the detective story, the gang planned to do in its former leader.
entries.zh: 在侦探故事中，团伙计划杀害前头目。

entries.en: The family chronicle records that she died in childbed.
entries.zh: 家族编年史记载，她在分娩时去世。

entries.en: The library acquired a philatelic collection documenting early postal routes.
entries.zh: 图书馆购入了一批记录早期邮路的集邮藏品。

entries.en: The telescope mount permits observations near the zenithal point.
entries.zh: 这座望远镜支架允许在接近天顶的位置进行观测。

entries.en: She did up the gift in silver paper and red ribbon.
entries.zh: 她用银色纸和红丝带包好了礼物。

entries.en: The villagers look upon the ruined tower as a local landmark.
entries.zh: 村民们把那座破塔视为当地的地标。

entries.en: Her careful records are demonstrative of the project's thorough planning.
entries.zh: 她细致的记录证明了这个项目规划周密。

entries.en: He threw a fit when someone moved his carefully arranged papers.
entries.zh: 有人挪动了他仔细摆好的文件，他大发脾气。

entries.en: Our new organizer is a ball of fire who finishes tasks before lunch.
entries.zh: 我们的新组织者精力充沛，午饭前就能完成任务。

entries.en: An art student sketched the fountain from the library steps.
entries.zh: 一名艺术专业学生在图书馆台阶上画喷泉速写。

entries.en: The textbook's skin disorders section includes a page on folliculitis.
entries.zh: 教材的皮肤病部分有一页介绍毛囊炎。

entries.en: The cream's label says it is designed to moisturise dry hands.
entries.zh: 这款乳霜的标签说，它的设计用途是滋润干燥的双手。

entries.en: The case report described edematous tissue around the injured ankle.
entries.zh: 病例报告描述了受伤脚踝周围的水肿组织。

entries.en: The weaker team began to fight back after conceding two goals.
entries.zh: 较弱的一队在丢掉两球后开始反击。

entries.en: The map shows the islands within the wider theater of war.
entries.zh: 地图标出了更大范围战区内的各座岛屿。

entries.en: Once in a while, we take the ferry instead of driving.
entries.zh: 我们偶尔乘渡轮，不开车。

entries.en: With two part-time jobs, he managed to squeeze by until graduation.
entries.zh: 靠着两份兼职，他勉强维持到毕业。

entries.en: The historian analyzed censorship under the military government.
entries.zh: 历史学家分析了军政府统治下的审查制度。

entries.en: The experiment's mass ratios supported the law of constant proportion.
entries.zh: 实验得到的质量比支持了定比律。

entries.en: The bridge model includes a margin of safety for unexpected loads.
entries.zh: 桥梁模型为意外载荷留出了安全余量。

entries.en: The headmaster spoke magisterially from the raised platform.
entries.zh: 校长站在高台上威严地讲话。

entries.en: The trainee summarized a published case of thyroiditis for the seminar.
entries.zh: 实习生为研讨会概述了一例已发表的甲状腺炎病例。

entries.en: The training video showed a surgeon preparing to ligate a vessel.
entries.zh: 培训视频展示了一名外科医生准备结扎血管的情景。

entries.en: The food company recalled a batch with incorrect labels.
entries.zh: 这家食品公司召回了一批标签错误的产品。

entries.en: Bright floodlights illuminated the stadium for the night game.
entries.zh: 明亮的泛光灯为夜场比赛照亮了体育场。

entries.en: The diagram uses a geological time scale to arrange the fossil discoveries.
entries.zh: 这张图用地质时标排列化石发现。

entries.en: At first blush, the two paintings appear almost identical.
entries.zh: 乍看之下，这两幅画几乎一模一样。

entries.en: She bought a job lot of old tools at the auction.
entries.zh: 她在拍卖会上买下了一整批旧工具。

entries.en: Guests may bring a significant other to the anniversary dinner.
entries.zh: 宾客可以携伴参加周年晚宴。

entries.en: A ripe loquat fell from the tree beside our gate.
entries.zh: 一颗熟枇杷从门边的树上掉了下来。

entries.en: The lensman waited patiently for the last cloud to pass.
entries.zh: 摄影师耐心等待最后一片云飘过。

entries.en: He pulled a coverall over his clothes before entering the paint booth.
entries.zh: 进入喷漆间前，他在衣服外面套上了工作服。

entries.en: The accounts cover a civil year, ending on December 31.
entries.zh: 账目涵盖一个历年，于十二月三十一日结束。

entries.en: The trade school teaches welding in its new workshop.
entries.zh: 这所职业学校在新车间教授焊接。

entries.en: With every exit blocked, the cornered wolves stood at bay.
entries.zh: 所有出口都被堵住，陷入绝境的狼群转身面对追赶者。

entries.en: He rabbited on about his new boat throughout dinner.
entries.zh: 整顿晚饭，他都在喋喋不休地谈自己的新船。

entries.en: The mechanic will check out the brakes before our trip.
entries.zh: 出发前，机械师会检查刹车。

entries.en: The swimmer missed the world record by a fraction of a second.
entries.zh: 这名游泳选手以不到一秒的差距错过了世界纪录。

entries.en: The memoir follows a City man through his career in London banking.
entries.zh: 这本回忆录讲述了一位金融家在伦敦银行业的职业生涯。

entries.en: The competitor balanced the caber before attempting the toss.
entries.zh: 选手先稳住长树干，再尝试将它抛出。

entries.en: The exercise involves the subsumption of these examples under broader categories.
entries.zh: 这项练习要求把这些例子归入更广泛的类别。

entries.en: The report tracks short-term borrowing costs in the money market.
entries.zh: 报告追踪了货币市场中的短期借款成本。

entries.en: She kept the intrusive reporter at arm's length throughout the visit.
entries.zh: 整个访问期间，她都与那位爱打探的记者保持距离。

entries.en: We arrived too soon and found the doors still locked.
entries.zh: 我们来得太早，发现门还锁着。

entries.en: The dictator kept critics' names in a secret black book.
entries.zh: 独裁者把批评者的名字记在一本秘密黑名单中。

entries.en: The manufacturer added kitchen furniture to its existing business line.
entries.zh: 制造商在现有业务范围中增加了厨房家具。

entries.en: The laboratory catalog lists gonadotropin among the hormones available for research.
entries.zh: 实验室目录把促性腺激素列入可供研究的激素清单。

entries.en: The linguist distinguished sentential meaning from the meanings of individual words.
entries.zh: 语言学家区分了句子意义与单个词的意义。

entries.en: The conductor held the chord at the fermata before lowering her baton.
entries.zh: 指挥在延长记号处保持和弦，然后才放下指挥棒。

entries.en: The quiet walk put her in a better frame of mind.
entries.zh: 安静地散步让她的心境好转了。

entries.en: The chemistry assignment asks us to compare each compound's heat of formation.
entries.zh: 化学作业要求我们比较各化合物的生成热。

entries.en: His two-base hit brought the runner home from second.
entries.zh: 他的二垒打让二垒跑者跑回了本垒。

entries.en: The survey recorded plant life growing beside the abandoned railway.
entries.zh: 调查记录了废弃铁路旁生长的植物。

entries.en: Ticket sales began to fall off after the opening week.
entries.zh: 首周过后，门票销量开始减少。

entries.en: She agreed to sign over the cottage to her daughter.
entries.zh: 她同意签字把小屋转让给女儿。

entries.en: Their mischievousness caused trouble when they hid the teacher's chalk.
entries.zh: 他们藏起老师粉笔的恶作剧惹了麻烦。

entries.en: An unshaped lump of clay waited beside the potter's wheel.
entries.zh: 一团未成形的黏土放在陶轮旁。

entries.en: Wildflowers covered the untilled field beyond the barn.
entries.zh: 谷仓那边未耕种的田地上开满了野花。

entries.en: The family next door lent us their ladder.
entries.zh: 隔壁一家人把梯子借给了我们。

entries.en: The school's field day ended with a relay race.
entries.zh: 学校的体育比赛日以接力赛结束。

entries.en: These measurements are comparable with last year's results because we used identical equipment.
entries.zh: 这些测量值可以与去年的结果比较，因为我们使用了相同的设备。

entries.en: We described the cart's motion in a frame of reference fixed to the track.
entries.zh: 我们在固定于轨道的参照系中描述了小车的运动。

entries.en: Her practical suggestions were a breath of fresh air after hours of argument.
entries.zh: 争论数小时后，她切实可行的建议让人耳目一新。

entries.en: The official sealed the writ of election before dispatching it.
entries.zh: 官员在发出选举令前盖上了印章。

entries.en: The firefighters beat back the flames before they reached the cottages.
entries.zh: 消防员在火焰烧到小屋前压住了火势。

entries.en: One tenpin remained standing after her first throw.
entries.zh: 她第一球投出后，还剩一个球瓶站着。

entries.en: Pack clean underclothing in the small overnight bag.
entries.zh: 把干净的内衣裤放进过夜用的小包里。

entries.en: The morning haziness softened the outline of the distant hills.
entries.zh: 清晨的薄雾使远山的轮廓变得朦胧。

entries.en: We turned onto a side road to avoid the traffic jam.
entries.zh: 我们转入一条岔路，避开堵车。

entries.en: The fallen tree brought down a power line across the road.
entries.zh: 倒下的树扯断了一条电力线，横在路上。

entries.en: You must log on before viewing the archived reports.
entries.zh: 查看存档报告前，你必须先登录。

entries.en: The children gathered in the game room while dinner was prepared.
entries.zh: 准备晚饭时，孩子们聚在娱乐室里。

entries.en: The memoir describes her brief employment as a party girl entertaining wealthy guests.
entries.zh: 回忆录描述了她短暂受雇担任聚会女招待、招待富裕宾客的经历。

entries.en: The crew repainted the water line along the ship's hull.
entries.zh: 船员重新漆了船身上的吃水线。

entries.en: A rubberneck leaned over the railing to watch the film crew.
entries.zh: 一个好奇的围观者探身越过栏杆，看摄制组工作。

entries.en: The deepness of the well made its bottom invisible.
entries.zh: 井太深，看不见井底。

entries.en: The redolence of orange blossom filled the courtyard.
entries.zh: 橙花的芬芳弥漫在院子里。

entries.en: Take hold of the rail before stepping onto the moving boat.
entries.zh: 踏上晃动的船之前，先抓住栏杆。

entries.en: The psychology class fitted a power law to the perceived loudness data.
entries.zh: 心理学课堂用幂律拟合了主观响度数据。

entries.en: The experiment measured reaction time after each brief flash.
entries.zh: 实验测量了每次短暂闪光后的反应时间。

entries.en: The American hotel placed its reception desk on the first floor, beside the street entrance.
entries.zh: 这家美国酒店把接待台设在第一层，紧挨着临街入口。

entries.en: The lecturer used a law of thermodynamics to explain the energy balance.
entries.zh: 讲师用一条热力学定律解释了能量平衡。

entries.en: The characters are carnally attracted but remain emotionally distant.
entries.zh: 这些人物在肉体上相互吸引，感情上却依然疏远。

entries.en: The popinjay boasted about his medals throughout the entire dinner.
entries.zh: 那个自负的家伙整顿晚饭都在吹嘘自己的奖章。

entries.en: The palace dome shone resplendently after the restoration.
entries.zh: 修复后，宫殿穹顶闪耀着灿烂的光辉。

entries.en: The new estimate differs from the old one by an order of magnitude.
entries.zh: 新估计值与旧估计值相差一个数量级。

entries.en: We decided to take a chance on the unfamiliar route.
entries.zh: 我们决定冒险走那条不熟悉的路线。

entries.en: The editor replaced the four-letter word with a row of asterisks.
entries.zh: 编辑用一排星号替换了那句粗话。

entries.en: In the film, the contractor tries to buy off the inspector.
entries.zh: 影片中，承包商企图买通检查员。

entries.en: Tourism brought new jobs in the service industry to the town.
entries.zh: 旅游业给镇上的服务行业带来了新工作岗位。

entries.en: During the shortage, stolen fuel appeared on the black market.
entries.zh: 短缺期间，被盗的燃油出现在黑市上。

entries.en: The musicians carried their instruments through the side door.
entries.zh: 乐手们从侧门搬进乐器。

entries.en: The new throughway carries trucks around the crowded town center.
entries.zh: 新的过境公路让卡车绕过拥挤的市中心。

entries.en: The flood lastingly altered the village's relationship with the river.
entries.zh: 洪水持久地改变了村庄与河流的关系。

entries.en: The station will retransmit the signal to the remote valley.
entries.zh: 中继站会把信号转发到偏远山谷。

entries.en: The business community offered apprenticeships to local school leavers.
entries.zh: 企业界为当地离校学生提供了学徒岗位。

entries.en: Turn the jacket inside out before checking the lining.
entries.zh: 先把夹克里外翻过来，再检查内衬。

entries.en: Affordable transport became a bread-and-butter issue for workers in the district.
entries.zh: 负担得起的交通成了这个地区工人的生计问题。

entries.en: The coach frowns on players arriving late to practice.
entries.zh: 教练不赞成队员训练迟到。

entries.en: Their narrow town house shares walls with homes on both sides.
entries.zh: 他们那栋狭窄的联排住宅与两侧住宅共用墙壁。

entries.en: The porter walked off before we could ask where our bags were.
entries.zh: 我们还来不及问行李在哪儿，搬运工就径自走了。
